# Third-party files

These are bundled with the app so it works fully offline and never has to contact another
website to draw the page.

| File | What it is | Source | Licence |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `plotly-cartesian-2.27.0.min.js` | Plotly.js 2.27.0, cartesian build (line, bar, histogram and box charts) | npm package `plotly.js-cartesian-dist-min` | MIT, see `plotly-LICENSE.txt` |
| `fonts/space-grotesk-*.woff2` | Space Grotesk variable font (weights 300 to 700), Latin, extended Latin and Vietnamese subsets | npm package `@fontsource-variable/space-grotesk` 5.3.0 | SIL Open Font License 1.1, see `fonts/OFL.txt` |
